verdict.reasoning: The rendered page 881 (printed Index p. 859) shows exactly these six lines at the top of the left column, and the markdown's first paragraph carries every word and every page number (649, 375, 490, 333, 512) in the same order with nothing missing, added or moved. The only difference is that the line breaks and the sub-entry indentation were lost when the lines were joined into one paragraph. That is line wrapping and formatting in the back-of-book index, not a content discrepancy: the same entries and page references stay in the same place, so the meaning does not change. The claim quotes both sources correctly, but it describes a formatting artifact, not misplaced content.
